unspecified.behavior: After a successful unlock or setup completion, the `finally` block re-enables the submit button while the full page load is still in flight.

scores.reason: This only matters if the user clicks again during the brief reload. That click re-POSTs unlock or complete-setup, and the user still lands on the target page.

On every successful unlock (unlock/page.tsx:35 then :43) or setup completion (CompleteStep.tsx:58 then :62), the button turns enabled again and its label goes back from the loading text while window.location.href loads. On a home LAN this lasts only a moment. A second click in that moment sends a harmless extra unlock, or re-runs the setup writes just before the page is replaced.
